title: Official blog knowledge stage 5
summary: This iteration hardens official blog admission triage for OpenAI and Anthropic knowledge records. First-pass triage now uses only the title plus opening preview paragraphs, excludes generic partnership or company-news framing even when broad workflow/tools/API/SDK words appear, and keeps concrete product, model, harness, agent workflow, eval, safety-methodology, or implementation-practice previews admissible.

lessons.lesson: Official blog knowledge admission needs a stronger company-news boundary than generic keyword matching.
lessons.evidence: The red tests showed generic partnership workflow news and generic API partnership news were previously classifiable as `needs_review`; Stage 5 now excludes company-news framing unless the opening preview contains concrete reusable implementation detail.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future official blog ingestion tied to product/model/engineering knowledge value rather than broad enterprise AI wording.

lessons.lesson: First-pass official blog triage should be based on the opening preview, not the full article body.
lessons.evidence: A multi-paragraph summary whose later paragraph contained architecture/eval terms now remains excluded when the opening preview is ordinary partnership news.
lessons.recommended_action: When adding live ingestion, pass only title plus crawler opening paragraphs into the triage helper before any full-article summarization.

lessons.lesson: Borderline customer or partnership stories should remain reviewable when implementation detail is visible early.
lessons.evidence: Stage 5 preserves `needs_review` for opening previews that mention routing architecture, tool permissions, evaluation harnesses, observability, or rollout controls.
lessons.recommended_action: Admit borderline company/customer stories only after a second read confirms reusable architecture, eval, permissions, workflow, or rollout lessons.

suggestions.issue: The official blog triage helper could overreact to broad words like workflow, tools, API, or SDK inside ordinary partnership announcements.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 5 adds admission-threshold tests and implementation logic for opening-preview extraction plus concrete implementation-detail gating; an independent verifier found a bare API/SDK edge case, which was fixed with an additional red/green test.
suggestions.suggestion: Use title plus opening preview and require concrete reusable implementation detail before reviewing company-news framed official blog candidates.
suggestions.expected_benefit: The official blog knowledge graph avoids low-value partnership/news filler while still capturing new products, models, harness engineering, agent workflow, eval, safety, and implementation-practice posts.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through deterministic triage tests and repository validation.

followups.action: Add a separate ingestion stage that fetches OpenAI/Anthropic RSS or index previews, passes only title plus opening paragraphs into triage, and writes accepted candidates to an internal review queue rather than public pages.
If live ingestion later stores candidate decisions, keep admission rationale in internal authoring data and publish only accepted, curated knowledge summaries.
